items.title: Nike (NKE) Put Vietnam’s First Fully Electric Container Barge Into Service
items.summary: Nike (NYSE: NKE) has launched Vietnam’s first fully electric container barge with shipping partner CMA CGM to cut logistics emissions. The vessel is scheduled to operate on key inland waterway routes that connect Nike’s Vietnamese manufacturing sites to export hubs. CMA CGM supplies the electric barge and operational expertise, while Nike uses it for regular cargo movements within its supply chain. The electric container barge initiative is important.
